title: EnableAll - RefCollectionAlias
content:
Member of: RefCollectionAlias Script Calls EnableNoWait on all the references in the collection. Syntax: Function EnableAll(bool bFadeIn = false) Parameters: - bFadeIn: Whether to fade in or not Default: False Return Value: None. Examples: ; Enable all the items in the collection HiddenGems.EnableAll()
; Enable all the items with fading Ghosts.EnableAll(true) Notes: Because this uses EnableNoWait, the references will not necessarily have their 3d loaded or even be enabled by the time this function returns. See Also: - RefCollectionAlias Script - EnableNoWait - ObjectReference
